subject: Coord: Marketplace + SI co-sell demo availability (Redwood x AWS x Nebula)
content:
Message 1 - Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0800
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@nebulasys.com>
Subject: Intro + co-sell marketplace demo — availability?

Hi Marissa,

Quick intro — I work on the AWS Marketplace GTM team. Nebula (SI) is running a joint outreach with a few ISVs and they asked if Redwood could do a short co-sell demo (30–40m) focused on marketplace listing, entitlement flow, and a quick walkthrough of Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Do you have 2–3 times next week that would work for a joint call (Jordan + Priya + 2–3 from Redwood)? We anticipate these folks will attend:
- Anita Kapoor (Nebula)
- Priya Desai (Nebula)
- Jordan Smith (AWS)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 3, 10:00–10:40
- Wed Mar 4, 09:00–09:40
- Thu Mar 5, 13:00–13:40

If none of those work we can sync calendar and flex.

Thanks,
Jordan
AWS Marketplace — Partner GTM

----

Message 2 - Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0800
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Subject: Fwd: Intro + co-sell marketplace demo — availability?

Forwarding — AWS and Nebula want a short co-sell / marketplace demo focused on listing & entitlements. They suggested 30–40m. Can you both join (Sergio you on GTM, Laura you on product/entitlements). Rafael for support on Dedicated runbook if needed.

Notes:
- Goal: agree demo agenda + owner for entitlements flow and Dedicated demo.
- I'd like a short customer-facing deck (3 slides: listing, entitlement flow, Dedicated options + ask for next steps).

My availability: Tue 10:00 or Thu 13:00 PST works best. If you prefer, propose alternatives and I'll reply to Jordan.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

----

Message 3 - Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0800
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro + co-sell marketplace demo — availability?

Marissa — I can do Tue 10 but not Thu. I can cover marketplace listing overview and the high-level entitlements flow. Laura — can you handle the Dedicated/Private demo? If it's short we can do a 35m split: 10m listing, 10m entitlements, 15m Dedicated Q&A.

Will prep a 3-slide deck and share by EOD. Rafael — could you have a one-slide ops bullet list ready (SLA, capacity, security blurbs)?

Sergio
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

----

Message 4 - Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:06:00 -0700
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@nebulasys.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan.smith@aws-partners.amazon.com
Cc: anita.kapoor@nebulasys.com
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell marketplace demo — availability?

Thanks — Tue 10:00 PST works for Nebula and AWS. One ask: could the demo include a short segment on how entitlements are enforced post-purchase (tokens/integration points)? Our PM wants to see the enforcement architecture for procurement customers.

Also FYI, Anita (Ops) will join to cover partner enablement steps.

Regards,
Priya
Director, Partner Solutions — Nebula Systems

----

Message 5 - Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0800
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jordan.smith@aws-partners.amazon.com, priya.desai@nebulasys.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell marketplace demo — availability?

Great — locking Tue Mar 3, 10:00–10:35 PST. Agenda (tentative):
- 10:00–10:03: Intros (Jordan + Priya + Anita + Redwood team)
- 10:03–10:12: Marketplace listing & entitlement model (Sergio)
- 10:12–10:22: Entitlement enforcement & procurement flow (Laura)
- 10:22–10:30: Dedicated/Private demo (Rafael)
- 10:30–10:35: Next steps + ask (Marissa)

Attachments: Redwood_AWS-co-sell-deck-v2.pdf (internal demo deck, 3 slides) and proposed-demo-times.ics (calendar stub). I'll send a calendar invite shortly from my calendar.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: [Redwood_AWS-co-sell-deck-v2.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)], [proposed-demo-times.ics (calendar event)]

----

Message 6 - Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:35:00 -0700
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.desai@nebulasys.com, anita.kapoor@nebulasys.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Tiny request from AWS GTM: could you add a one-slide slide after the entitlements section that shows "typical customer adoption timeline" (PO → entitlement provisioning → first-call success metrics)? If Rafael can include one ops bullet there that's perfect.
